cover: Historic electoral upsets and cross-border missile strikes reshape global political fault lines
cover_scene: A ballot box rests upon a fractured stone map of the world against a stormy twilight sky, surrounded by scattered voting slips and distant smoke.

slides.scene: A crowded Belgrade boulevard filled with youth holding aloft Serbian flags beneath overcast skies, surrounding a monumental parliament building.
slides.headline: Vučić Concedes Defeat in Snap Serbian Election
slides.body: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat in snap parliamentary elections following record voter turnout. A galvanized student protest movement led the opposition breakthrough, effectively unseating the long-ruling establishment after nearly two years of widespread demonstrations.

slides.scene: Air defense interceptors leave curving smoke trails in the night sky over a sprawling modern desert metropolis.
slides.headline: Yemeni Strikes Target Deep Inside Saudi Arabia
slides.body: Yemeni forces launched coordinated missile and drone strikes hitting airports and oil facilities across Saudi Arabia. Riyadh intercepted incoming salvos as debris injured two people, sending Saudi and Egyptian financial markets tumbling while regional escalation concerns mounted.

slides.scene: A woman raises her hands before an enormous crowd waving Venezuelan flags in a sunlit plaza in Caracas.
slides.headline: Opposition Leader María Corina Machado Returns to Venezuela
slides.body: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado made a surprise return from nearly a year in exile, reuniting with supporters in Caracas. Her return challenges state authorities following contested national elections and intensifies domestic pressure for democratic restoration.

slides.scene: A crowded football stadium illuminated by floodlights under a clear night sky, with players celebrating on the pitch.
slides.headline: Real Madrid Tops Barcelona in Thrilling El Clásico
slides.body: Real Madrid defeated Barcelona 2-1 away, becoming the first team to beat their rivals in La Liga this season. The result tightened the league title race as teenage star Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé squared off.
